messages:
maya: Quick sync — need <30m feedback on hero lines for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages. Goal: one A/B per mode for launch posts + a webinar CTA and inbound routing map. If no major blockers by EOD I'll lock copy and brief creative.

maya: Draft hero options (super short):
- Hosted: 'Start small. Scale instantly. Hosted LLMs with simple SDKs and streaming.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and production SLAs.'
- Private: 'Private deployment (VPC & on‑prem) for regulated data and strict controls.'

maya: Benchmarks to call out on the pages: latency-first examples, cost-per-token ranges (guidance), and a short note about automated regressions tied to evals. Routing: webinar signups -> growth webinar pipeline; product-interest -> AE demo flow; bench requests -> trials + benchmark folder.

devin: Hosted line — can we tighten to "Hosted: start in minutes, pay-as-you-go inference with streaming & SDKs"? "Scale instantly" feels fluffy. Also suggest an alt CTA: "See latency & pricing" vs just "Get started".

li: Love the simplicity. Recommend shorter headlines and a 1-line subhead that clarifies the benefit: e.g. Hosted subhead: "Low-lift integration, predictable latency for protos." Dedicated subhead: "Committed capacity, consistent p99s for production." Private subhead: "Full network isolation and key management." Also flag spacing in mobile hero.

sam: We should avoid numeric claims unless we can back them (legal). Rather than exact ms, use "industry-leading" or "low-latency". For Dedicated — call out "reserved GPUs" + "burst capacity" as a differentiator. For landing A/B: A = performance-first message, B = economics-first message (cost/throughput).

nate: For webinar CTA text: "Join our launch webinar: How we keep inference fast & cheap" vs generic "Sign up". Routing note: map webinar -> nurture track (3 emails), hot leads -> SDR queue (tag: enterprise-interest), bench requests -> product eval team (auto-cc dev@). I can sketch the Zapier/webhook rules if you want.

webinar-bot: Upcoming webinar scheduled 2026-04-07 10:00 PDT — "Serving LLMs: cost, latency, and rollouts". Registration link: https://redwood.ai/webinar/reg

devin: +1 on specific CTAs. Also propose small benefit bullets under each hero: Hosted (SDKs, streaming), Dedicated (SLA, autoscale), Private (VPC, KMS). Keep bullets 3 items max.

li: Quick micro copy suggestions for the 3 A/B variants:
A (performance): "Deliver sub-100ms p50 for common prompts" (only if we can support)
B (economics): "Reduce per-token cost with smart batching & KV caching"
-> If we can't commit ms in A, use "sub-second p50" instead.

sam: Ops + legal check: we can claim "smart batching" and "KV caching" as platform features. Avoid exact savings percentages unless we have a benchmark doc linked. Consider an inline link to the benchmark blog for the claims.

nate: For inbound routing, simple mapping table (for engineers):
- webinar_reg -> tag:marketing_webinar -> nurture_flow
- demo_request (Dedicated/Private) -> assign:AE_team -> immediate outreach
- benchmark_download -> assign:product_eval -> trial + docs
I can make the webhook payload example today.

maya: This is great — action items:
- devin: finalize hero alt lines and CTAs by 3pm PT (include alt copy for mobile).
- li: prepare 2 hero comps (perf-first, economics-first) for hero + 3 bullets; mobile ready by 5pm.
- nate: draft the routing webhook payloads + SDR tags by EOD.
- sam: confirm legal-safe phrasing (no exact ms unless backed) and where to link benchmarks.
- maya: I'll consolidate into the launch post + webinar brief and share with growth.

maya: If no major objections, we'll run A/B test 50/50 for first week post-launch, then switch 80/20 to winner. Please react with :thumbsup: to sign off or flag blockers inline.
